query: For the paper "Predicting the Role of Political Trolls in Social Media" (arXiv: 1910.02001), answer this question: Do they only look at tweets?

drafts: No, they do not only look at tweets. Besides the text of the tweets of the troll accounts, they also use embeddings built on the user-to-user mention graph and the user-to-hashtag mention graph [11]. More generally, they leverage the community structure and the text of the messages in the online social network of trolls represented as a graph, from which they extract several types of embeddings for the trolls [3, 8].

Experiments on the “IRA Russian Troll” dataset show that our methodology im- proves over the state-of-the-art in the ﬁrst sce- nario, while providing a compelling case for the second scenario, which has not been ex- plored in the literature thus far.

In particular, we use a combination of em- beddings built on the user-to-user mention graph, the user-to-hashtag mention graph, and the text of the tweets of the troll accounts. We further explore several possible approaches using label propaga- tion for the distant supervision scenario. As a result of our approach, we improve the classiﬁcation accuracy by more than 5 percent- age points for the supervised learning scenario.
